from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Step 1: Find the "Introductory meeting" event on 2024-05-15 to get participants
intro_events = search_calendar_events("Introductory meeting", "2024-05-15")
if len(intro_events) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No 'Introductory meeting' event found on 2024-05-15.")

# Disambiguate if multiple events
class ParticipantsModel(BaseModel):
    participants: list[str]

intro_event = query_ai_assistant(
    "From the following events, select the one that is the 'Introductory meeting' on 2024-05-15 and return its participants.",
    ParticipantsModel
)
participants = intro_event.participants

# Step 2: Check if there is a conflicting event at 10:00 on 2024-05-19
events_0519 = get_day_calendar_events("2024-05-19")
start_10 = datetime.strptime("2024-05-19 10:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
end_10 = start_10 + timedelta(hours=1)

class ConflictModel(BaseModel):
    conflict: bool

conflict_10 = query_ai_assistant(
    "Given these events, is there any event that overlaps with 10:00 to 11:00 on 2024-05-19? Return True if there is a conflict, otherwise False.",
    ConflictModel
)

if conflict_10.conflict:
    start_time = "2024-05-19 16:00"
    end_time = "2024-05-19 17:00"
else:
    start_time = "2024-05-19 10:00"
    end_time = "2024-05-19 11:00"

# Step 3: Create the new event
create_calendar_event(
    title="Follow-up meeting",
    start_time=start_time,
    end_time=end_time,
    description="Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.",
    participants=participants,
    location=None
)
